gossip.protocol: synchronous graph-only serialized neighbor state exchange
gossip.byte_scope: Tensor values plus JSON IDs, weights, ranks, shapes, dtypes, names and eight-byte header length; excludes network framing, graph setup, optimizer/base-model state.
gossip.memory_scope: Logical decoded per-peer inbox tensors; excludes model/optimizer state, wire buffers, merge workspace, and the single-process coordinator's copies.

evaluation_assembly.protocol: neighbor-only BFS factor-record gather, root assembly, optional dissemination
evaluation_assembly.byte_scope: Tensor values plus JSON IDs, weights, ranks, shapes, dtypes, names and eight-byte header length; excludes network framing, graph setup, optimizer/base-model state.
evaluation_assembly.memory_scope: Logical per-peer gather record tensors; root explicitly stores every source record. Excludes original training model, wire buffers, Python objects, optimizer state and merge/SVD workspace; output and largest wire buffer are reported separately.
